info.title: CCIP API
info.description:
API for Cross-Chain Interoperability Protocol (CCIP).

**⚠️ Deprecation Notice:** v1 is deprecated. Please migrate to v2 [staging](https://api.ccip.cldev.cloud/docs) | [production](https://api.ccip.chain.link/docs).

get.summary: Get all intent statuses for a transaction
get.description:
Retrieve the status of all intents created in a specific transaction.
Supports batched intents where multiple intents are created in a single transaction.
This endpoint can be used to obtain intent IDs after initiating intent transactions.
Please favour using `/intents/id/{intentId}` to query intent status after obtaining the intent ID.

This may be required on some routes for some time.

example.message: No intents found for the provided transaction hash
An unexpected error occurred while processing the request

get.description:
Retrieve the status of a specific intent by its intentId.

**Important**: Use the `intentId` returned by `/intents/tx/{txHash}`. Intent IDs
are provider-prefixed (e.g., `EC-...` or `EO-...`). Raw `0x...` transaction hashes
are not valid intent IDs - use `/intents/tx/{txHash}` to look up by transaction hash.

parameters.name: x-api-key
parameters.description:
API key to validate caller. This is not entirely public yet.
This may be required on some routes for some time.

parameters.name: intentId
parameters.description:
Unique intent identifier returned by `/intents/tx/{txHash}`.
Must be a provider-prefixed ID (e.g., `EC-...` or `EO-...`), not a raw `0x...` hash.

401.description: Unauthorized - Invalid or missing API key

example.message: Intent not found with the provided ID
An unexpected error occurred while processing the request

origin.description: Address of the user account that originally initiated the transaction (tx.origin) on the source chain. Format depends on source chain family (20-byte hex for EVM, base58 for Solana).

messageId.description:
Globally unique message identifier derived from a hash of:
- Source/destination chain selectors and onRamp address (for lane uniqueness)
- Message content (sender, receiver, data, tokens, fees, extraArgs)
- Sequence number and nonce (for ordering and replay protection)
This ensures global uniqueness across all CCIP lanes and prevents replay attacks.

sender.description:
Address of the account that called ccipSend() on the source chain router.
Format depends on source chain family (20-byte hex for EVM, base58 for Solana).

receiver.description:
Address of the intended recipient contract/account on the destination chain.
Format depends on destination chain family. Encoded as bytes in the message.

status.description:
The current status of the CCIP message through its lifecycle:
- `SENT`: Transaction submitted and waiting for source chain confirmation
- `SOURCE_FINALIZED`: Transaction confirmed on source chain and ready for CCIP processing
- `COMMITTED`: Message committed to destination chain's commit store and staged for execution
- `BLESSED`: Message approved by CCIP oracle network and ready for execution
- `SUCCESS`: Message successfully executed on destination chain
- `FAILED`: Message execution failed but can be manually retried

sourceNetworkInfo.description: Information about the blockchain network where the message originated

destNetworkInfo.description: Information about the blockchain network where the message will be executed

routerAddress.description:
Address of the CCIP router contract that processed this message on the source chain.
May be null if the router address is not available.

sendTransactionHash.description:
Transaction hash of the ccipSend() call on the source chain.
Format depends on source chain family.

sendTimestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the message was sent.

receiptTransactionHash.description:
Transaction hash of the message execution on the destination chain.
Null if message hasn't been executed yet. Format depends on destination chain family.

receiptTimestamp.description:
ISO 8601 timestamp when the message was executed on destination chain.
Null if message hasn't been executed yet.

data.description: Arbitrary data payload to be delivered to the receiver contract encoded as hex string.

feeToken.description: Address of the token used to pay CCIP fees on the source chain.

feeTokenAmount.description: Amount of fee tokens paid for this message (in token's smallest unit).

tokenAmounts.description: Array of token transfers included in this message.

ready_for_manual_execution.description: Whether this message can be manually executed if automatic execution failed.

tokenAddress.description:
Address of the token contract on the source chain.
Format depends on source chain family.

amount.description:
Amount of tokens to transfer in the token's smallest unit (wei, lamports, etc.).
Must be positive and within token's transfer limits.

name.description:
Human-readable name identifier for the blockchain network.
Used for display purposes and network identification.

chainSelector.description:
The CCIP chain selector identifier for the network.
This is a uint64 value represented as a string.
See the official chain selectors repository: https://github.com/smartcontractkit/chain-selectors/blob/v1.0.60/selectors.yml

chainId.description: Native chain identifier (EIP-155 for EVM, genesis hash for SVM, etc.).

chainFamily.description:
Blockchain family/architecture type.
Determines message format, address encoding, and execution model.

sourceNetworkInfo.description: Source blockchain network information for this lane

destNetworkInfo.description: Destination blockchain network information for this lane

routerAddress.description: Address of the CCIP router contract on the source chain for this lane.

lane.description: The lane (source-destination pair) for which latency is measured

totalMs.description: 90th percentile latency in milliseconds for message delivery on this lane.

gasLimit.description:
Gas limit for message execution on the destination EVM chain.
Default is 200,000 gas if not specified in the original message.

allowOutOfOrderExecution.description:
Whether this message can be executed out of order relative to other messages 
from the same sender.

computeUnits.description: Compute units allocated for message execution on the destination SVM chain.

accountIsWritableBitmap.description:
Bitmap indicating which accounts in the accounts array are writable.
Each bit corresponds to an account position.

allowOutOfOrderExecution.description:
Whether this message can be executed out of order relative to other messages 
from the same sender.

tokenReceiver.description:
Address for token delivery, separate from the message receiver.
Required if the message includes token transfers.

accounts.description: Additional accounts needed for message execution on SVM.

sourceChainSelector.description:
CCIP chain selector for the source blockchain.
String representation of uint64 selector value.

destChainSelector.description:
CCIP chain selector for the destination blockchain.
String representation of uint64 selector value.
Can be the same as sourceChainSelector for same-chain swaps (e.g., Solana token swaps).

inputToken.description:
Token address on the origin chain. For EVM chains use 0x-prefixed hex addresses,
for Solana use base58-encoded SPL token mint addresses.

outputToken.description:
Desired token address on the destination chain. For EVM chains use 0x-prefixed
hex addresses, for Solana use base58-encoded SPL token mint addresses.

inputAmount.description:
Amount of input tokens in smallest unit (e.g., wei for ETH, lamports for SOL).
Must be a positive integer string to preserve precision.

sender.description:
Address initiating the intent. For EVM this is the msg.sender (not tx.origin),
for Solana this is the user's wallet address.

receiver.description:
Address receiving tokens on the destination chain. For EVM use 0x-prefixed
hex addresses, for Solana use base58-encoded wallet addresses.

calldata.description:
Optional execution data as hex-encoded bytes for arbitrary contract calls.
**Supported on some routes only** - may be rejected on routes that only support
token transfers. When unsupported, omit this field or set to `0x`.
Not supported for Solana/SVM intents.

extraOptions.description:
Chain-specific options for intent creation. Currently only SVMIntentOptionsV1
is supported (for Solana). Ignored for EVM chains.

inputAmount.description: Echo of the requested input amount for confirmation.

expectedOutputAmount.description:
Expected amount of output tokens after all fees.
In smallest unit of the output token.
May be omitted if the provider does not return this estimate.

estimatedExecutionTime.description:
Estimated time for intent execution in seconds.
May be omitted if the provider does not return timing estimates.

deadline.description:
Unix timestamp for **quote validity**. Submit the transaction before this time;
after this, the quote is stale and should be re-fetched.
Note: Some routes encode a separate, longer on-chain intent deadline inside the
transaction data (for solver fulfillment). This `deadline` field represents the
shorter quote validity window, not the on-chain deadline.

chainFamily.description:
Chain family for this transaction. Use this to determine how to interpret
other fields. Current values: "EVM" (0x addresses, hex data) or "SVM"
(base58 addresses, base64 data).

transactionPurpose.description:
Purpose of this transaction.
- INTENT: The actual intent transaction to submit on-chain.
- LOOKUP_TABLE_CREATION: A prerequisite transaction that creates a Solana lookup table.
  Submit this first, then poll the quotes endpoint again to get the intent transaction.
  Only applicable for SVM chains.

to.description: Target address to invoke. Format depends on chainFamily.

data.description:
Transaction data to submit as-is. Format depends on chainFamily
(hex for EVM, base64 for SVM).

value.description: Native token value to send with the transaction, typically "0" for intents.

chainId.description:
Chain identifier from the intent provider.
For EVM chains: numeric chain ID (e.g., "1" for Ethereum).
For SVM chains: provider's domain identifier.
Use chainFamily to determine how to interpret this value.

intentId.description: Unique identifier for the intent. Use it with `/intents/id/{intentId}` to query status.

transactionHash.description: Intent creation transaction hash on origin chain.

status.description:
High-level intent status.
PENDING: Intent is processing.
COMPLETED: Intent has been fulfilled.
FAILED: Intent has failed and cannot be fulfilled.

subStatus.description: Detailed status from the underlying route. Route-specific; use for display only.

sourceChainSelector.description: CCIP chain selector where the intent was created.

destChainSelector.description: CCIP chain selector where the intent will be fulfilled.

fulfillmentTxHash.description: Transaction hash of fulfillment on destination chain. Populated when completed.

sender.description: Address that initiated the intent on source chain.

inputToken.description: Token address sent on source chain.

outputToken.description: Token address received on destination chain.

inputAmount.description: Amount sent on source chain in token's smallest unit.

outputAmount.description: Actual amount received on destination chain. Populated when completed.

createdAt.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) when the intent was created.

filledAt.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) when the intent was filled on destination chain.

SVMIntentOptionsV1.description:
Optional Solana-specific parameters for intent creation. All fields are optional.
If omitted, sensible defaults will be used (e.g., the user's associated token account).

userTokenAccountPublicKey.description: Sender's token account. Defaults to sender's ATA.

programVaultAccountPublicKey.description:
Intent program vault account, tokens transferred to here for custody.
Defaults to program's ATA.

tags.name: Lanes

tags.name: Intents
tags.description:
Operations related to intents (cross-chain swaps and bridges).

**ERC20 Approval Required**: Before submitting an intent transaction for token routes,
the caller must approve `inputToken` allowance to the returned `transaction.to` address
for at least `inputAmount`. The intent transaction will transfer tokens from the sender
to the protocol contract.
